<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>K.I.N.D — Command Center</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--pur:#6d28d9;--pur2:#8b5cf6;--ink:#1c1726;--soft:#6b6478;--line:#ece8f4;--bg:#faf9fd;--card:#fff}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px 24px 80px}
.eyebrow{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pur);font-weight:500}
h1{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,46px);margin:8px 0 6px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.lede{color:var(--soft);font-size:16px;max-width:640px;line-height:1.5}
.tracker{margin:30px 0 8px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--pur),var(--pur2));border-radius:18px;padding:26px 28px;color:#fff;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:0 12px 30px -12px rgba(109,40,217,.5)}
.tracker h2{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:21px;margin:0 0 6px}
.tracker p{margin:0;opacity:.92;font-size:14px;max-width:520px;line-height:1.5}
.tracker button{background:#fff;color:var(--pur);font-weight:600;border:0;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:11px;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap;transition:transform .15s}
.tracker button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.section{margin-top:38px}
.section-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin-bottom:4px}
.section h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:20px;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.section .count{font-family:'JetBrains Mono';font-size:12px;color:var(--soft)}
.section .sub{color:var(--soft);font-size:14px;margin:2px 0 18px;line-height:1.5}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:14px}
.card{text-align:left;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 18px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:border-color .15s,transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.card:hover{border-color:var(--pur2);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 26px -16px rgba(28,23,38,.3)}
.card-title{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:600;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink)}
.card-desc{color:var(--soft);font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;flex:1}
.card-go{font-size:13px;color:var(--pur);font-weight:600;margin-top:4px}.card-go span{transition:margin .15s}.card:hover .card-go span{margin-left:4px}
.foot{margin-top:48px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:18px;color:var(--soft);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;font-family:'JetBrains Mono'}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,16,30,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);display:none;z-index:50;padding:20px}
.ov.on{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.ovbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;color:#fff;padding:4px 6px 12px;gap:12px}
.ovbar .t{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:600;font-size:16px}
.ovbar .btns{display:flex;gap:8px}
.ovbar button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:9px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;font-weight:500}
.ovbar button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.26)}
.ovframe{flex:1;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.ovframe iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block}
@media(max-width:600px){.wrap{padding:28px 16px 60px}.tracker{padding:22px}}
</style></head><body>
<div class="wrap">
  <div class="eyebrow">K.I.N.D · operating cockpit</div>
  <h1>Command Center</h1>
  <p class="lede">Every calculator, the live tracker, the system blueprint and the operating playbook in one place. Owner tools tell you what people cost; recruiting tools show candidates what they'll earn.</p>
  <div class="tracker"><div>
      <h2>Live Sales &amp; Cost Tracker</h2>
      <p>The full 5-year model — every AE, partner and the agent on their own tab, the operating team, and the company P&amp;L. Your planning sandbox and the spec the live engine is built from.</p>
    </div><button onclick="downloadSheet()">Download the tracker ↓</button></div>
  <div class="section"><div class="section-head"><h3>The system</h3><span class="count">2 docs</span></div>
    <div class="sub">How the live machine fits together, and how to actually run the business. Share these with whoever builds the portal.</div><div class="grid"><button class="card" onclick="openTool('blueprint','Live System Blueprint')">
          <div class="card-title">Live System Blueprint</div><div class="card-desc">How Stripe, attribution, the engine and the portals wire together</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('playbook','Founder’s Operating Playbook')">
          <div class="card-title">Founder’s Operating Playbook</div><div class="card-desc">Five systems, six numbers, the rhythm, tools &amp; HMRC/Xero</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button></div></div>
  <div class="section"><div class="section-head"><h3>Owner & internal</h3><span class="count">7 tools</span></div>
    <div class="sub">What each rep or channel costs you, and what the company nets. Keep these to yourself.</div><div class="grid"><button class="card" onclick="openTool('ae_gen_int','AE Commission — Owner')">
          <div class="card-title">AE Commission — Owner</div><div class="card-desc">Custom AE: cost, 5-yr net, break-even for any inputs</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('ae_ent_int','Enterprise AE — Owner')">
          <div class="card-title">Enterprise AE — Owner</div><div class="card-desc">£1,500 deals · £112.5k OTE · what the rep costs you</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('ae_mm_int','Mid-Market AE — Owner')">
          <div class="card-title">Mid-Market AE — Owner</div><div class="card-desc">£700 deals · £75k OTE · cost &amp; company net</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('ae_smb_int','SMB AE — Owner')">
          <div class="card-title">SMB AE — Owner</div><div class="card-desc">£400 deals · £50k OTE · cost &amp; company net</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('partner_int','Partner — Owner')">
          <div class="card-title">Partner — Owner</div><div class="card-desc">Channel economics: what a partner costs vs returns</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('psm_int','Partner Sales Manager — Owner')">
          <div class="card-title">Partner Sales Manager — Owner</div><div class="card-desc">What the PSM channel nets you after her 10% + 5%</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('team_pnl','Team P&amp;L')">
          <div class="card-title">Team P&amp;L</div><div class="card-desc">Full roster P&amp;L with editable headcount &amp; starts</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button></div></div>
  <div class="section"><div class="section-head"><h3>Recruiting — show candidates</h3><span class="count">6 tools</span></div>
    <div class="sub">Open these in front of an AE, partner or sales manager you're hiring. Let the climb sell the role.</div><div class="grid"><button class="card" onclick="openTool('ae_gen_earn','AE Earnings — Candidate')">
          <div class="card-title">AE Earnings — Candidate</div><div class="card-desc">What an AE takes home — any tier, any inputs</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('ae_ent_earn','Enterprise AE — Earnings')">
          <div class="card-title">Enterprise AE — Earnings</div><div class="card-desc">Show an enterprise recruit their 5-year climb</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('ae_mm_earn','Mid-Market AE — Earnings')">
          <div class="card-title">Mid-Market AE — Earnings</div><div class="card-desc">Show a mid-market recruit their 5-year climb</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('ae_smb_earn','SMB AE — Earnings')">
          <div class="card-title">SMB AE — Earnings</div><div class="card-desc">Show an SMB recruit their 5-year climb</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('partner_earn','Partner — Earnings')">
          <div class="card-title">Partner — Earnings</div><div class="card-desc">What a partner earns: 20% on signing + 5% retained</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button>
<button class="card" onclick="openTool('psm_earn','Partner Sales Manager — Earnings')">
          <div class="card-title">Partner Sales Manager — Earnings</div><div class="card-desc">What she earns: 10% personal + 5% override climbing</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button></div></div>
  <div class="section"><div class="section-head"><h3>Statement</h3><span class="count">1 tool</span></div>
    <div class="sub">A clean monthly payout statement for any rep or tier.</div><div class="grid"><button class="card" onclick="openTool('statement','Commission Statement')">
          <div class="card-title">Commission Statement</div><div class="card-desc">Per-rep monthly payout statement (any tier)</div>
          <div class="card-go">Open <span>→</span></div></button></div></div>
  <div class="foot">14 calculators + statement + blueprint + operating playbook embedded · tracker .xlsx embedded for download · all £ · model: Land 20% / Retain 5% / Expand 5% · 93% gross margin</div>
</div>
<div class="ov" id="ov">
  <div class="ovbar"><div class="t" id="ovt"></div><div class="btns"><button onclick="popTool()">Open in new tab ↗</button><button onclick="closeTool()">Close ✕</button></div></div>
  <div class="ovframe"><iframe id="ovf" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-forms"></iframe></div>
</div>
<script id="payload" type="application/json">{"blueprint": "", "playbook": "", "ae_gen_int": "", "ae_ent_int": "", "ae_mm_int": "", "ae_smb_int": "", "partner_int": "", "psm_int": "", "team_pnl": "", "ae_gen_earn": "", "ae_ent_earn": "", "ae_mm_earn": "", "ae_smb_earn": "", "partner_earn": "", "psm_earn": "", "statement": ""}</script>
<script id="sheet" type="application/octet-stream"></script>
<script>
const TOOLS=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('payload').textContent);let cur=null;
function html(id){return decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(TOOLS[id])));}
function openTool(id,title){cur=id;document.getElementById('ovt').textContent=title;document.getElementById('ovf').srcdoc=html(id);document.getElementById('ov').classList.add('on');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';}
function closeTool(){document.getElementById('ov').classList.remove('on');document.getElementById('ovf').srcdoc='';document.body.style.overflow='';}
function popTool(){if(!cur)return;const b=new Blob([html(cur)],{type:'text/html'});window.open(URL.createObjectURL(b),'_blank');}
function downloadSheet(){const b64=document.getElementById('sheet').textContent.trim();const bin=atob(b64);const arr=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)arr[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);const blob=new Blob([arr],{type:'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='KIND-Sales-Commission-Tracker.xlsx';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeTool();});
</script></body></html>
